review_scope_limitation: Reference-specific checks are not verification of every citation and every theological proposition. The manuscript remains an internal research draft; no blanket content approval may be inferred.
required_before_public_release: Check each of 134 substantive claims against linked editions or identified author positions; do not treat generic document links as proof.
Proofread 142 French passages, including eight labeled internal follow-ups.
Replace normalized TLM051–065 summaries with vetted full debate arguments, or intentionally approve shorter format.
Resolve or document missing TLM001–025 corpus without inventing historical text.
Check canonical ownership/cross-module dedup and test navigation and external source links in the target build.
